reason: Both CIFs parse as primitive P1, Z=1 structures with 12 fully occupied sites and the correct Sr2FeCuPb2O6 composition, and the reduced cell gives strong line coverage (all 142 detected peaks with prominence >=1 are within 0.03 degrees 2theta). However, no submitted atomic realization is sufficiently established. A complete periodic-neighbor audit of selected.cif finds decisive physical failures: Pb-O = 1.0445 A, Cu-O = 1.4300 A, Cu-Pb = 1.8492 A, and O-O = 1.7856 A; bond-valence assignment fails, with the 1.0445 A contact producing a Pb bond-valence sum near 34.6. Thus its custom unweighted full-profile residual of 0.104 cannot validate the coordinates. alternative-1.cif is structurally distinct and avoids the worst overlap, but its full-profile residual is much worse (0.188), its bond-valence assignment also fails, and it does not constitute a comparably supported realization. The trace shows neither independent convergence of the complete coordinate model nor quantitative tests of the remaining element-ordering choices. Another solution attempt in the well-indexed primitive cell is therefore likely to add a materially different viable atomic candidate.
